statement: Carry-Free R5 The integer kernel of Phi_B: Z^m -> Z is generated by the adjacent carry vectors g_j = B e_j - e_{j+1}, j=0,...,m-2. Standard module/kernel calculation; useful because it completely characterizes every positional collision.

statement: Carry-Free R5/R20 CF-01 Phi_B is injective on [-A,A]^m ∩ Z^m iff B>2A (for m>=2). The least integer base is 2A+1. Classical balanced positional representation fact; exact sharp statement is an important campaign asset.

statement: Carry-Free R1/R5/R20 Let r=(r_0,...,r_{m-1}) be an integer vector with |r_j|<=A. For Phi_B(r)=sum_j r_j B^j and m>=2, Phi_B(r)=0 implies r=0 for every such r iff B>A. Elementary/classical arithmetic; rediscovered and sharpened inside the campaign. Historical novelty not claimed.

statement: Let digit caps `m_i>=1` and radices `B_i` satisfy \[ B_i\ge 2m_i-1. \] Put \[ Q_1=1,\qquad Q_i=\prod_{j<i}B_j, \qquad E(x)=\sum_{i=1}^d x_iQ_i, \] for digits `0<=x_i<m_i`. If \[ E(x)+E(z)=2E(y), \] then \[ x_i+z_i=2y_i\quad\text{for every }i. \]
proof: Set `c_i=x_i+z_i-2y_i`. Then \[ \sum_i c_iQ_i=0, \qquad |c_i|\le2(m_i-1)<B_i. \] Reducing modulo `B_1` gives `c_1=0`. Divide by `B_1` and repeat inductively. QED.

statement: For \(m\ge2\), the implication \[ r\in[-A,A]^m,\qquad \Phi_B(r)=0 \Longrightarrow r=0 \] holds for every \(r\) if and only if \(B>A\).
proof: Assume \(B>A\) and \(\Phi_B(r)=0\). If \(r\neq0\), let \(t\) be the least index with \(r_t\neq0\). Then \[ 0=\sum_{j=t}^{m-1}r_jB^j =B^t\left(r_t+B\sum_{j=t+1}^{m-1}r_jB^{j-t-1}\right). \] Hence \(B\mid r_t\). But \(0<|r_t|\le A<B\), impossible. If \(B\le A\), then \[ r=(-B,1,0,\ldots,0) \] is legal, nonzero, and satisfies \(\Phi_B(r)=0\).

statement: For a positive integer \(B\), every such \(P\) satisfies \(P(B)\neq0\) if and only if \(B>C\).
proof: Factor \(P(X)=X^tQ(X)\), where \(Q(0)=c\neq0\). If \(P(B)=0\), then \(Q(B)=0\) and \[ c=-B(\text{an integer}), \] so \(B\mid c\). If \(B>C\), this is impossible because \(0<|c|\le C\). Conversely, for \(B\le C\), \(P(X)=X-B\) is a valid counterexample.
